up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726934. Only include compounds that have a SMILES structure (i.e., their canonical SMILES is not null). For each such compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name, and its canonical SMILES. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726934' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
